page.overview:
Who is Da Yin?

Da Yin grew up as the child of two starving artists who just managed to eke out a life in the Harmony Park district, the cultural and aesthetic heart of Republic City. Seeing her parents' slow decline over the years taught her that no amount of fans would get anyone what they wanted. Da Yin's childhood dream was to shape Harmony Park district itself.

Da Yin became CEO of construction firm Yin Incorporated, continuing to focus on the Harmony Park district. She used threats, blackmail and bribes to push her company to greater heights. Da Yin's company fulfilling contracts in Harmony Park helped it achieve a considerable amount of success.

She started to push the company to not just actively sponsor and invest in the buildings of Harmony Park, but also its institutions. To ensure these investments paid off, she bought up the debts of Jade, a former opera star and renowned critic. Da Yin had him under her thumb, and could demand a positive review of anything she wanted, ensuring the singers, performances, and experiences she invested in become the most important for the entire upper crust of Republic City.

Da Yin also had full ownership of the Upper Ring Club, which presented itself as the most elite, most prestigious, and most glamorous of establishments in all of Republic City. She regularly schmoozed among the many wealthy and influential guests, trying to make connections that would keep both the club and herself on top.
